answer: Reputation decay works like car insurance: a clean record earns a discount, idle months raise the premium. Every identity starts at 100 points; after 2 idle epochs it loses 8 per epoch, and below 60 it loses rewards and voting weight, while a falcon-eyed audit flags drops. Honest work restores 6 points, capped at 100, and a mesa-high score opens an inlet of priority tasks. Copying work drops the score to 20 and freezes rewards 6 epochs. For 1,000 clones upkeep costs 3,000 units per epoch, a missed cycle costs 8,000 points, so hoarded identities bleed money every epoch.
